    35→//==============================================================================
    36→// Runtime Configuration (loaded from SD card)
    37→//==============================================================================
    38→struct RuntimeConfig {
    39→    float wakeWordThreshold = DEFAULT_WAKE_THRESHOLD;
    40→    float embedThreshold = DEFAULT_EMBED_THRESHOLD;
    41→    float llmTemperature = DEFAULT_LLM_TEMPERATURE;
    42→    float llmTopP = DEFAULT_LLM_TOPP;
    43→    int llmMaxTokens = 128;
    44→    unsigned long idleSleepMs = IDLE_SLEEP_MS;
    45→    int recordDurationMs = RECORD_DURATION_MS;
    46→} runtimeConfig;
    47→
    48→//==============================================================================
    49→// Global Objects
    50→//==============================================================================
    51→
    52→VideoPlayer video;
    53→OrientationManager orientation;
    54→
    55→// Phase 2: Audio and wake word
    56→MicStream micStream;
    57→AudioRecorder recorder;
    58→WakeWordDetector wakeWord;
    59→
    60→// Phase 3: Embedding + similarity search
    61→AudioEmbedder audioEmbed;
    62→EmbeddingSearch embedSearch;
    63→float* queryEmbedding = nullptr;  // 256-dim embedding buffer
    64→SearchResult lastSearchResult;
    65→
    66→// Phase 4: LLM inference
    67→LLMInference llmInference;
    68→String llmResponse;  // Accumulated response for display
    69→bool llmGenerating = false;
    70→
    71→// Phase 5: TTS
    72→RobotTTS tts;
    73→bool ttsSpeaking = false;
    74→
    75→// Memory pool for ML models (6MB in PSRAM)
    76→uint8_t* mlPool = nullptr;
    77→
    78→// Current application state
    79→BadgeState currentState = STATE_BOOT;
    80→unsigned long lastActivityTime = 0;
    81→
    82→// Wake word active flag (disabled during certain states)
    83→bool wakeWordActive = false;
    84→
    85→// Mode switches
    86→bool voiceDisabled = false;  // BTN1: when true, logo loops forever
    87→
    88→//==============================================================================
    89→// Memory Pool Management
    90→//==============================================================================
    91→
    92→bool initMemoryPool() {
    93→    mlPool = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(ML_POOL_SIZE);
    94→    if (!mlPool) {
    95→        Serial.println("ERROR: ML pool allocation failed");
    96→        return false;
    97→    }
    98→    Serial.printf("ML Pool: %dKB allocated\n", ML_POOL_SIZE / 1024);
    99→    return true;
   100→}

   102→//==============================================================================
   103→// Mode Switch Helpers
   104→//==============================================================================
   105→
   106→void initSwitches() {
   107→    // Configure output pins (always LOW)
   108→    pinMode(BTN1_OUT, OUTPUT);
   109→    digitalWrite(BTN1_OUT, LOW);
   110→    pinMode(BTN2_OUT, OUTPUT);
   111→    digitalWrite(BTN2_OUT, LOW);
   112→
   113→    // Configure input pins with internal pull-up
   114→    pinMode(BTN1_IN, INPUT_PULLUP);
   115→    pinMode(BTN2_IN, INPUT_PULLUP);
   116→}
   117→
   118→bool isBTN1Bridged() {
   119→    // Returns true when switch is bridged (input pulled LOW by output)
   120→    return digitalRead(BTN1_IN) == LOW;
   121→}
   122→
   123→bool isBTN2Bridged() {
   124→    // Returns true when switch is bridged (input pulled LOW by output)
   125→    return digitalRead(BTN2_IN) == LOW;
   126→}
   127→
   128→void enterDeepSleep() {
   129→    Serial.println("Entering deep sleep mode...");
   130→
   131→    // Turn off display backlight
   132→    digitalWrite(LCD_BL, LOW);
   133→
   134→    // Configure BTN2_IN as wake-up source (when switch is opened, pin goes HIGH)
   135→    // Wake on HIGH (switch opened)
   136→    esp_sleep_enable_ext0_wakeup((gpio_num_t)BTN2_IN, HIGH);
   137→
   138→    // Enter deep sleep
   139→    Serial.println("Sleeping...");
   140→    delay(100);  // Let serial flush
   141→    esp_deep_sleep_start();
   142→}
   143→
   144→//==============================================================================
   145→// Configuration Loading
   146→//==============================================================================
   147→
   148→bool loadConfig() {
   149→    File f = SD.open(CONFIG_PATH);
   150→    if (!f) {
   151→        Serial.println("Config: Using defaults (no config.json)");
   152→        return false;
   153→    }
   154→
   155→    StaticJsonDocument<512> doc;
   156→    DeserializationError error = deserializeJson(doc, f);
   157→    f.close();
   158→
   159→    if (error) {
   160→        Serial.printf("Config: Parse error - %s\n", error.c_str());
   161→        return false;
   162→    }
   163→
   164→    // Load values with defaults as fallback
   165→    runtimeConfig.wakeWordThreshold = doc["wake_word_threshold"] | DEFAULT_WAKE_THRESHOLD;
   166→    runtimeConfig.embedThreshold = doc["embed_threshold"] | DEFAULT_EMBED_THRESHOLD;
   167→    runtimeConfig.llmTemperature = doc["llm_temperature"] | DEFAULT_LLM_TEMPERATURE;
   168→    runtimeConfig.llmTopP = doc["llm_topp"] | DEFAULT_LLM_TOPP;
   169→    runtimeConfig.llmMaxTokens = doc["llm_max_tokens"] | 128;
   170→    runtimeConfig.idleSleepMs = doc["idle_sleep_ms"] | IDLE_SLEEP_MS;
   171→    runtimeConfig.recordDurationMs = doc["record_duration_ms"] | RECORD_DURATION_MS;
   172→
   173→    Serial.println("Config: Loaded from SD card");
   174→    Serial.printf("  embed_threshold: %.2f\n", runtimeConfig.embedThreshold);
   175→    Serial.printf("  llm_temperature: %.2f\n", runtimeConfig.llmTemperature);
   176→    Serial.printf("  llm_max_tokens: %d\n", runtimeConfig.llmMaxTokens);
   177→
   178→    return true;
   179→}
   180→
   181→//==============================================================================
   182→// LLM Token Callback (Phase 4)
   183→//==============================================================================
   184→
   185→void onLLMToken(const char* token, void* userData) {
   186→    // Append token to response buffer and display
   187→    llmResponse += token;
   188→    video.appendText(token);
   189→    Serial.print(token);  // Also print to serial for debugging
   190→}
   191→
   192→//==============================================================================
   193→// State Machine Helpers
   194→//==============================================================================
   195→
   196→void setState(BadgeState newState) {
   197→    if (currentState == newState) return;
   198→
   199→    Serial.printf("State: %d -> %d\n", currentState, newState);
   200→
   201→    // Exit current state
   202→    switch (currentState) {
   203→        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
   204→            // Stop wake word detection and mic stream
   205→            if (wakeWordActive) {
   206→                wakeWord.end();
   207→                micStream.end();
   208→                wakeWordActive = false;
   209→            }
   210→            break;
   211→        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
   212→            video.hideText();
   213→            break;
   214→        case STATE_RECORDING:
   215→            recorder.stopRecording();
   216→            break;
   217→        default:
   218→            break;
   219→    }
   220→
   221→    currentState = newState;
   222→    lastActivityTime = millis();
   223→
   224→    // Enter new state
   225→    switch (newState) {
   226→        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
   227→            video.resume();
   228→            // Start wake word detection (unless voice disabled by BTN1)
   229→            if (!voiceDisabled && mlPool) {
   230→                if (micStream.begin()) {
   231→                    if (wakeWord.begin(mlPool, ML_POOL_SIZE, WAKE_MODEL_PATH, WAKE_CONFIG_PATH)) {
   232→                        wakeWordActive = true;
   233→                        Serial.printf("Listening for \"%s\"...\n", wakeWord.getWakeWord());
   234→                        // Refresh display after SD card access (wake word model loading)
   235→                        video.refreshDisplay();
   236→                    } else {
   237→                        Serial.println("Wake word init failed");
   238→                        micStream.end();
   239→                    }
   240→                } else {
   241→                    Serial.println("Mic stream init failed");
   242→                }
   243→            } else if (voiceDisabled) {
   244→                Serial.println("Voice disabled - logo loop only");
   245→            }
   246→            break;
   247→        case STATE_RECORDING:
   248→            // Pause video during recording
   249→            video.pause();
   250→            recorder.startRecording(runtimeConfig.recordDurationMs / 1000.0f);
   251→            break;
   252→        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
   253→            // Keep logo playing - response already spoken via TTS
   254→            video.resume();
   255→            video.hideText();
   256→            break;
   257→        case STATE_EMBEDDING:
   258→            // Keep video paused during processing (no text - looks cleaner)
   259→            video.pause();
   260→            video.hideText();
   261→            printPSRAM("before audio encoder");
   262→            // Load audio encoder model
   263→            if (!audioEmbed.begin(mlPool, ML_POOL_SIZE, AUDIO_ENCODER_PATH)) {
   264→                Serial.println("Audio encoder init failed - returning to logo");
   265→                setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   266→            } else {
   267→                printPSRAM("after audio encoder");
   268→            }
   269→            break;
   270→        case STATE_SIMILARITY:
   271→            // Audio encoder unloaded, search against embeddings
   272→            audioEmbed.end();
   273→            // Keep video paused (no text)
   274→            break;
   275→        case STATE_TTS_SORRY:
   276→            // Keep logo playing - just speak the apology, no text needed
   277→            video.resume();
   278→            video.hideText();
   279→            ttsSpeaking = true;
   280→            break;
   281→        case STATE_TTS_OUTPUT:
   282→            // Pause video to show LLM response text
   283→            video.pause();
   284→            video.refreshDisplay();
   285→            video.fillScreen(0x0000);  // BLACK background for text
   286→            if (llmResponse.length() > 0) {
   287→                video.showText(llmResponse.c_str());
   288→            }
   289→            ttsSpeaking = true;
   290→            break;
   291→        case STATE_LLM_INFERENCE:
   292→            // Pause video to show streaming LLM text
   293→            video.pause();
   294→            video.refreshDisplay();
   295→            video.fillScreen(0x0000);  // BLACK background for text
   296→            video.clearText();
   297→            video.showText("");  // Initialize empty text box
   298→            llmResponse = "";
   299→            llmGenerating = true;
   300→
   301→            // CRITICAL: Free everything possible to make room for LLM model (~7MB needed)
   302→            // The search result is already saved in lastSearchResult.intent
   303→            Serial.println("Freeing memory for LLM...");
   304→
   305→            // Free embeddings (~2MB)
   306→            embedSearch.end();
   307→            printPSRAM("after embed unload");
   308→
   309→            // Free ML pool (~1MB) - LLM doesn't use it
   310→            if (mlPool) {
   311→                free(mlPool);
   312→                mlPool = nullptr;
   313→                Serial.println("Freed ML pool");
   314→            }
   315→
   316→            // Free video buffer (~1.2MB) - we only need display for text
   317→            video.unloadVideo();
   318→            printPSRAM("after video unload");
   319→
   320→            // Load LLM model
   321→            Serial.println("Loading LLM model...");
   322→            if (!llmInference.begin(nullptr, 0, LLM_MODEL_PATH, TOKENIZER_PATH)) {
   323→                Serial.println("LLM init failed - showing intent only");
   324→                video.showText(lastSearchResult.intent);
   325→                llmGenerating = false;
   326→                // Reload video buffer
   327→                video.reloadVideo();
   328→                // Reload embeddings since LLM failed
   329→                embedSearch.begin(EMBEDDINGS_PATH, INTENTS_PATH);
   330→                // Reallocate ML pool
   331→                if (!mlPool) {
   332→                    mlPool = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(ML_POOL_SIZE);
   333→                }
   334→                setState(STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE);
   335→            } else {
   336→                // Apply runtime config
   337→                llmInference.setTemperature(runtimeConfig.llmTemperature);
   338→                llmInference.setTopP(runtimeConfig.llmTopP);
   339→                llmInference.setMaxTokens(runtimeConfig.llmMaxTokens);
   340→            }
   341→            break;
   342→        default:
   343→            break;
   344→    }
   345→}
   346→
   347→void resetActivityTimer() {
   348→    lastActivityTime = millis();
   349→}
   350→
   351→//==============================================================================
   352→// State Handlers
   353→//==============================================================================
   354→
   355→void handleLogoLoop() {
   356→    // Update orientation
   357→    orientation.update();
   358→    if (orientation.hasChanged()) {
   359→        video.setRotation(orientation.getRotation());
   360→    }
   361→
   362→    // Play video frame
   363→    video.play();
   364→
   365→    // Check wake word if active
   366→    if (wakeWordActive) {
   367→        if (micStream.update()) {
   368→            // New features available, run wake word detection
   369→            if (wakeWord.detect(micStream.getFeatures())) {
   370→                Serial.println(">>> WAKE WORD DETECTED! <<<");
   371→                setState(STATE_RECORDING);
   372→            }
   373→        }
   374→    }
   375→}
   376→
   377→// Counter for recording filenames
   378→static int recordingCounter = 0;
   379→
   380→void handleRecording() {
   381→    // Update recording (video paused)
   382→    if (recorder.update()) {
   383→        // Recording complete
   384→        Serial.printf("Recording done: %d samples (%.2fs)\n",
   385→                      recorder.getSampleCount(), recorder.getDurationSec());
   386→
   387→        // Save recording to SD card for debugging
   388→        char filepath[64];
   389→        snprintf(filepath, sizeof(filepath), "/recordings/rec_%04d.wav", recordingCounter++);
   390→
   391→        // Create recordings directory if needed
   392→        if (!SD.exists("/recordings")) {
   393→            SD.mkdir("/recordings");
   394→        }
   395→        recorder.saveToSD(filepath);
   396→
   397→        // Phase 3: Extract embedding from recording
   398→        setState(STATE_EMBEDDING);
   399→    }
   400→}
   401→
   402→void handleEmbedding() {
   403→    // Run audio embedding extraction (blocking operation)
   404→    if (audioEmbed.embed(recorder.getBuffer(), recorder.getSampleCount(), queryEmbedding)) {
   405→        Serial.println("Embedding extracted successfully");
   406→        setState(STATE_SIMILARITY);
   407→    } else {
   408→        Serial.println("Embedding extraction failed");
   409→        setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   410→    }
   411→}
   412→
   413→void handleSimilarity() {
   414→    // Search for closest embedding
   415→    lastSearchResult = embedSearch.search(queryEmbedding);
   416→
   417→    Serial.printf("Best match: %s (score: %.3f)\n",
   418→                  lastSearchResult.intent, lastSearchResult.score);
   419→
   420→    if (lastSearchResult.score >= runtimeConfig.embedThreshold) {
   421→        // Good match - run LLM inference
   422→        Serial.println("High confidence match!");
   423→        setState(STATE_LLM_INFERENCE);
   424→    } else {
   425→        // Low confidence - stash and apologize
   426→        Serial.println("Low confidence - stashing");
   427→        // TODO Phase 8: stash audio and embedding
   428→        setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   429→    }
   430→}
   431→
   432→void handleLLMInference() {
   433→    if (!llmGenerating) {
   434→        // Generation done - shouldn't normally get here as we transition immediately
   435→        setState(STATE_TTS_OUTPUT);
   436→        return;
   437→    }
   438→
   439→    // Run LLM generation (blocking, but streams tokens via callback)
   440→    Serial.printf("\nLLM generating response for: %s\n", lastSearchResult.intent);
   441→    int tokensGenerated = llmInference.generate(lastSearchResult.intent, onLLMToken, nullptr);
   442→    Serial.printf("\nLLM done: %d tokens\n", tokensGenerated);
   443→
   444→    llmGenerating = false;
   445→
   446→    // Unload LLM to free memory
   447→    llmInference.end();
   448→    printPSRAM("after LLM unload");
   449→
   450→    // Reload video buffer
   451→    Serial.println("Reloading video...");
   452→    if (!video.reloadVideo()) {
   453→        Serial.println("WARNING: Failed to reload video!");
   454→    }
   455→    printPSRAM("after video reload");
   456→
   457→    // Reload embeddings now that LLM is unloaded
   458→    Serial.println("Reloading embeddings...");
   459→    if (!embedSearch.begin(EMBEDDINGS_PATH, INTENTS_PATH)) {
   460→        Serial.println("WARNING: Failed to reload embeddings!");
   461→    }
   462→    printPSRAM("after embed reload");
   463→
   464→    // Reallocate ML pool for wake word / audio embed
   465→    if (!mlPool) {
   466→        mlPool = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(ML_POOL_SIZE);
   467→        if (mlPool) {
   468→            Serial.println("ML pool reallocated");
   469→        } else {
   470→            Serial.println("WARNING: ML pool reallocation failed!");
   471→        }
   472→    }
   473→    printPSRAM("after pool realloc");
   474→
   475→    // If no tokens generated, use the intent as fallback
   476→    if (tokensGenerated == 0 && llmResponse.length() == 0) {
   477→        llmResponse = lastSearchResult.intent;
   478→    }
   479→
   480→    // Transition to TTS to speak the response
   481→    setState(STATE_TTS_OUTPUT);
   482→}
   483→
   484→void handleDisplayResponse() {
   485→    // Auto-return to logo loop after 3 seconds
   486→    if (millis() - lastActivityTime > 3000) {
   487→        setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   488→    }
   489→}
   490→
   491→void handleTtsSorry() {
   492→    if (ttsSpeaking) {
   493→        // Speak apology (blocking)
   494→        tts.speak("Sorry, I could not understand that.");
   495→        ttsSpeaking = false;
   496→        lastActivityTime = millis();
   497→    }
   498→
   499→    // Wait a bit after speaking, then return to logo
   500→    if (millis() - lastActivityTime > 1000) {
   501→        setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   502→    }
   503→}
   504→
   505→void handleTtsOutput() {
   506→    if (ttsSpeaking) {
   507→        // Speak the LLM response (blocking)
   508→        if (llmResponse.length() > 0) {
   509→            tts.speak(llmResponse.c_str());
   510→        }
   511→        ttsSpeaking = false;
   512→        lastActivityTime = millis();
   513→    }
   514→
   515→    // Wait a bit after speaking, then return to logo
   516→    if (millis() - lastActivityTime > 1000) {
   517→        setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   518→    }
   519→}
   520→
   521→//==============================================================================
   522→// Main Loop State Machine
   523→//==============================================================================
   524→
   525→void loop() {
   526→    // Check mode switches first
   527→    // BTN2: Deep sleep when bridged
   528→    if (isBTN2Bridged()) {
   529→        enterDeepSleep();
   530→        // Won't reach here - ESP will reset on wake
   531→    }
   532→
   533→    // BTN1: Voice disable - check and update flag
   534→    bool btn1State = isBTN1Bridged();
   535→    if (btn1State != voiceDisabled) {
   536→        voiceDisabled = btn1State;
   537→        if (voiceDisabled) {
   538→            Serial.println("BTN1: Voice DISABLED");
   539→            // Stop wake word if currently active
   540→            if (wakeWordActive) {
   541→                wakeWord.end();
   542→                micStream.end();
   543→                wakeWordActive = false;
   544→            }
   545→        } else {
   546→            Serial.println("BTN1: Voice ENABLED");
   547→            // Will start wake word on next LOGO_LOOP transition
   548→        }
   549→    }
   550→
   551→    // State-specific handling
   552→    switch (currentState) {
   553→        case STATE_BOOT:
   554→            // Initialization complete, transition to logo loop
   555→            setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   556→            break;
   557→
   558→        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
   559→            handleLogoLoop();
   560→            break;
   561→
   562→        case STATE_RECORDING:
   563→            handleRecording();
   564→            break;
   565→
   566→        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
   567→            handleDisplayResponse();
   568→            break;
   569→
   570→        case STATE_EMBEDDING:
   571→            handleEmbedding();
   572→            break;
   573→
   574→        case STATE_SIMILARITY:
   575→            handleSimilarity();
   576→            break;
   577→
   578→        case STATE_TTS_SORRY:
   579→            handleTtsSorry();
   580→            break;
   581→
   582→        case STATE_LLM_INFERENCE:
   583→            handleLLMInference();
   584→            break;
   585→
   586→        case STATE_TTS_OUTPUT:
   587→            handleTtsOutput();
   588→            break;
   589→
   590→        // Future states (Phase 6+)
   591→        case STATE_STASH_DATA:
   592→        case STATE_DEEP_SLEEP:
   593→            // Not implemented yet - return to logo
   594→            setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   595→            break;
   596→    }
   597→}
   598→
   599→//==============================================================================
   600→// Debug Helper
   601→//==============================================================================
   602→
   603→void printPSRAM(const char* label) {
   604→    Serial.printf("PSRAM [%s]: %dKB free / %dKB total\n",
   605→                  label,
   606→                  ESP.getFreePsram() / 1024,
   607→                  ESP.getPsramSize() / 1024);
   608→}
   609→
   610→//==============================================================================
   611→// Setup
   612→//==============================================================================
   613→
   614→void setup() {
   615→    Serial.begin(115200);
   616→    delay(500);
   617→    Serial.println("\n=== OAISYS25 Badge Starting ===");
   618→    printPSRAM("boot");
   619→
   620→    // Initialize mode switches first (before any other init)
   621→    initSwitches();
   622→
   623→    // Check if BTN2 is bridged - go to deep sleep immediately
   624→    if (isBTN2Bridged()) {
   625→        Serial.println("BTN2 bridged - entering deep sleep");
   626→        enterDeepSleep();
   627→    }
   628→
   629→    // Check BTN1 for voice disable mode
   630→    voiceDisabled = isBTN1Bridged();
   631→    if (voiceDisabled) {
   632→        Serial.println("BTN1 bridged - voice detection DISABLED");
   633→    }
   634→
   635→    // Initialize orientation sensor (non-fatal if fails)
   636→    if (!orientation.begin()) {
   637→        Serial.println("IMU init failed - rotation disabled");
   638→    } else {
   639→        Serial.println("IMU: OK");
   640→    }
   641→
   642→    // Initialize video player FIRST (this also inits display and SD card)
   643→    // Must be before ML pool to avoid PSRAM fragmentation
   644→    Serial.println("Loading video...");
   645→    if (!video.begin()) {
   646→        Serial.println("ERROR: Video init failed!");
   647→        // Blink LED to indicate error
   648→        pinMode(LCD_BL, OUTPUT);
   649→        while (1) {
   650→            digitalWrite(LCD_BL, !digitalRead(LCD_BL));
   651→            delay(500);
   652→        }
   653→    }
   654→    Serial.println("Video: OK");
   655→    printPSRAM("after video");
   656→
   657→    // Load runtime configuration from SD card
   658→    loadConfig();
   659→
   660→    // Initialize audio recorder (allocates PSRAM buffer)
   661→    if (!recorder.begin()) {
   662→        Serial.println("WARNING: Audio recorder init failed!");
   663→    } else {
   664→        Serial.println("Recorder: OK");
   665→    }
   666→    printPSRAM("after recorder");
   667→
   668→    // Phase 3: Allocate query embedding buffer (16-byte aligned for ESP-DSP SIMD)
   669→    queryEmbedding = (float*)heap_caps_aligned_alloc(16,
   670→        AUDIO_EMBEDDING_DIM * sizeof(float), MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM);
   671→    if (!queryEmbedding) {
   672→        Serial.println("WARNING: Query embedding buffer alloc failed!");
   673→    } else {
   674→        Serial.println("Query buffer: OK (aligned)");
   675→    }
   676→
   677→    // Phase 3: Load embedding search database (stays in memory)
   678→    // IMPORTANT: Load embeddings BEFORE ML pool - they stay resident permanently
   679→    if (!embedSearch.begin(EMBEDDINGS_PATH, INTENTS_PATH)) {
   680→        Serial.println("WARNING: Embedding search init failed!");
   681→        Serial.println("  Make sure SD card has /data/embeddings.bin and /data/intents.txt");
   682→    } else {
   683→        Serial.printf("EmbedSearch: %d intents loaded\n", embedSearch.getCount());
   684→    }
   685→    printPSRAM("after embeddings");
   686→
   687→    // Allocate ML memory pool (after embeddings to ensure they get contiguous memory)
   688→    // Remaining PSRAM is used for ML models that load/unload dynamically
   689→    if (!initMemoryPool()) {
   690→        Serial.println("WARNING: ML features disabled (no pool)");
   691→    }
   692→    printPSRAM("after ML pool");
   693→
   694→    // Phase 5: Initialize TTS (non-fatal if fails)
   695→    if (!tts.begin()) {
   696→        Serial.println("WARNING: TTS init failed - speech disabled");
   697→    } else {
   698→        Serial.println("TTS: OK (SAM robotic voice)");
   699→        // Say hello on startup
   700→        tts.speak("Hello. I am ready.");
   701→    }
   702→
   703→    // Ready to go
   704→    lastActivityTime = millis();
   705→    currentState = STATE_BOOT;
   706→
   707→    Serial.println("\n=== Badge Ready (Phase 5) ===");
   708→    printPSRAM("final");
   709→    Serial.println("Say 'Hey Daisy' to start recording");
   710→    Serial.println("Recording -> Embedding -> Similarity -> LLM -> TTS");
   711→}

     1→# OAISYS25 Badge Firmware
     2→
     3→Unified firmware integrating all badge functionality.

     5→> **Plan:** `workbench/docs/OAISYS_BADGE_PLAN.md`
     6→> **Progress:** `workbench/docs/OAISYS_BADGE_TODO.md`
     7→
     8→## Phase 2: Wake Word + Recording (Current)
     9→- Video loop playback (MJPEG from SD card)
    10→- Gyro-based screen rotation
    11→- Wake word detection ("Hey Daisy")
    12→- Audio recording after wake word trigger
    13→
    14→## Hardware
    15→- ESP32-S3-LCD-2 (Waveshare)
    16→- ST7789 240x320 LCD
    17→- QMI8658 IMU
    18→- INMP441 Mics (x2)
    19→- MAX98357A Speaker
    20→- SD Card (for media, models, config)
    21→
    22→## Building
    23→1. Open `oaisys_badge.ino` in Arduino IDE 2.x
    24→2. Select Board: ESP32S3 Dev Module
    25→3. Settings:
    26→   - Flash: 16MB
    27→   - Partition: 16MB Flash (3MB APP/9MB FATFS)
    28→   - PSRAM: OPI PSRAM
    29→4. Upload sketch
    30→5. Copy `sd_data/*` contents to SD card root
    31→
    32→## Controls (Phase 2)
    33→- **Wake word**: Say "Hey Daisy" to start recording
    34→- Recording shows RED screen, completion shows GREEN
    35→- Auto-returns to video loop after 2 seconds
    36→
    37→## Directory Structure
    38→```
    39→oaisys_badge/
    40→├── oaisys_badge.ino    # Main sketch
    41→├── config.h            # Pin definitions
    42→├── src/                # Source files (Arduino compiles recursively)
    43→│   ├── display/
    44→│   │   └── video_player.*  # Video + text overlay
    45→│   ├── sensors/
    46→│   │   └── orientation.*   # IMU rotation
    47→│   ├── audio/              # (Phase 2)
    48→│   ├── ml/                 # (Phase 3-4)
    49→│   ├── tts/                # (Phase 5)
    50→│   ├── network/            # (Phase 7)
    51→│   └── storage/            # (Phase 7-8)
    52→└── sd_data/            # Files for SD card
    53→```

    55→**Note:** Arduino IDE 1.6.10+ recursively compiles `.cpp` files in `src/` subfolder.
    56→
    57→## SD Card Layout

    59→SD:/

    13→// Include MjpegClass inline to avoid separate header management
    14→#define READ_BUFFER_SIZE 1024
    15→
    16→class MjpegClass {
    17→public:
    18→    bool setup(Stream *input, uint8_t *mjpeg_buf, JPEG_DRAW_CALLBACK *pfnDraw,
    19→               bool useBigEndian, int x, int y, int widthLimit, int heightLimit) {
    20→        _input = input;
    21→        _mjpeg_buf = mjpeg_buf;
    22→        _pfnDraw = pfnDraw;
    23→        _useBigEndian = useBigEndian;
    24→        _x = x;
    25→        _y = y;
    26→        _widthLimit = widthLimit;
    27→        _heightLimit = heightLimit;
    28→        _inputindex = 0;
    29→
    30→        if (!_read_buf) {
    31→            _read_buf = (uint8_t *)malloc(READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    32→        }
    33→        return _read_buf != nullptr;
    34→    }
    35→
    36→    bool readMjpegBuf() {
    37→        if (_inputindex == 0) {
    38→            _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    39→            _inputindex += _buf_read;
    40→        }
    41→        _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
    42→        int i = 0;
    43→        bool found_FFD8 = false;
    44→
    45→        while ((_buf_read > 0) && (!found_FFD8)) {
    46→            i = 0;
    47→            while ((i < _buf_read) && (!found_FFD8)) {
    48→                if ((_read_buf[i] == 0xFF) && (_read_buf[i + 1] == 0xD8)) {
    49→                    found_FFD8 = true;
    50→                }
    51→                ++i;
    52→            }
    53→            if (found_FFD8) {
    54→                --i;
    55→            } else {
    56→                _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    57→            }
    58→        }
    59→
    60→        uint8_t *_p = _read_buf + i;
    61→        _buf_read -= i;
    62→        bool found_FFD9 = false;
    63→
    64→        if (_buf_read > 0) {
    65→            i = 3;
    66→            while ((_buf_read > 0) && (!found_FFD9)) {
    67→                if ((_mjpeg_buf_offset > 0) && (_mjpeg_buf[_mjpeg_buf_offset - 1] == 0xFF) && (_p[0] == 0xD9)) {
    68→                    found_FFD9 = true;
    69→                } else {
    70→                    while ((i < _buf_read) && (!found_FFD9)) {
    71→                        if ((_p[i] == 0xFF) && (_p[i + 1] == 0xD9)) {
    72→                            found_FFD9 = true;
    73→                            ++i;
    74→                        }
    75→                        ++i;
    76→                    }
    77→                }
    78→
    79→                memcpy(_mjpeg_buf + _mjpeg_buf_offset, _p, i);
    80→                _mjpeg_buf_offset += i;
    81→                size_t o = _buf_read - i;
    82→
    83→                if (o > 0) {
    84→                    memcpy(_read_buf, _p + i, o);
    85→                    _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf + o, READ_BUFFER_SIZE - o);
    86→                    _p = _read_buf;
    87→                    _inputindex += _buf_read;
    88→                    _buf_read += o;
    89→                } else {
    90→                    _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    91→                    _p = _read_buf;
    92→                    _inputindex += _buf_read;
    93→                }
    94→                i = 0;
    95→            }
    96→            return found_FFD9;
    97→        }
    98→        return false;
    99→    }
   100→
   101→    bool drawJpg() {
   102→        _remain = _mjpeg_buf_offset;
   103→
   104→        if (_jpeg.openRAM(_mjpeg_buf, _remain, _pfnDraw) != 1) return false;
   105→
   106→        if (_scale == -1) {
   107→            int iMaxMCUs;
   108→            int w = _jpeg.getWidth();
   109→            int h = _jpeg.getHeight();
   110→            float ratio = (float)h / _heightLimit;
   111→
   112→            if (ratio <= 1) {
   113→                _scale = 0;
   114→                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 16;
   115→            } else if (ratio <= 2) {
   116→                _scale = JPEG_SCALE_HALF;
   117→                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 8;
   118→                w /= 2;
   119→                h /= 2;
   120→            } else if (ratio <= 4) {
   121→                _scale = JPEG_SCALE_QUARTER;
   122→                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 4;
   123→                w /= 4;
   124→                h /= 4;
   125→            } else {
   126→                _scale = JPEG_SCALE_EIGHTH;
   127→                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 2;
   128→                w /= 8;
   129→                h /= 8;
   130→            }
   131→
   132→            _jpeg.setMaxOutputSize(iMaxMCUs);
   133→            _x = (w > _widthLimit) ? 0 : ((_widthLimit - w) / 2);
   134→            _y = (_heightLimit - h) / 2;
   135→        }
   136→
   137→        if (_useBigEndian) {
   138→            _jpeg.setPixelType(RGB565_BIG_ENDIAN);
   139→        }
   140→
   141→        if (_jpeg.decode(_x, _y, _scale) != 1) {
   142→            _jpeg.close();
   143→            return false;
   144→        }
   145→
   146→        _jpeg.close();
   147→        return true;
   148→    }
   149→
   150→    void reset() {
   151→        _inputindex = 0;
   152→        _buf_read = 0;
   153→        _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
   154→    }
   155→
   156→private:
   157→    Stream *_input;
   158→    uint8_t *_mjpeg_buf;
   159→    JPEG_DRAW_CALLBACK *_pfnDraw;
   160→    bool _useBigEndian;
   161→    int _x, _y, _widthLimit, _heightLimit;
   162→    uint8_t *_read_buf = nullptr;
   163→    int32_t _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
   164→    JPEGDEC _jpeg;
   165→    int _scale = -1;
   166→    int32_t _inputindex = 0;
   167→    int32_t _buf_read;
   168→    int32_t _remain = 0;
   169→};

   171→//==============================================================================
   172→// MemoryStream Implementation
   173→//==============================================================================
   174→
   175→MemoryStream::MemoryStream(uint8_t* buffer, size_t size)
   176→    : _buffer(buffer), _size(size), _position(0) {}
   177→
   178→int MemoryStream::available() {
   179→    return _size - _position;
   180→}
   181→
   182→int MemoryStream::read() {
   183→    return (_position < _size) ? _buffer[_position++] : -1;
   184→}
   185→
   186→int MemoryStream::peek() {
   187→    return (_position < _size) ? _buffer[_position] : -1;
   188→}
   189→
   190→size_t MemoryStream::readBytes(char* buffer, size_t length) {
   191→    size_t n = min(length, _size - _position);
   192→    memcpy(buffer, _buffer + _position, n);
   193→    _position += n;
   194→    return n;
   195→}
   196→
   197→void MemoryStream::reset() {
   198→    _position = 0;
   199→}

   248→bool VideoPlayer::_loadVideo(const char* path) {
   249→    File f;
   250→
   251→    // Initialize SPI bus (FSPI) and SD card - same bus as display
   252→    static SPIClass sdSpi(FSPI);
   253→    sdSpi.begin(SD_SCK, SD_MISO, SD_MOSI, SD_CS);
   254→    if (!SD.begin(SD_CS, sdSpi)) {
   255→        Serial.println("SD card init failed!");
   256→        return false;
   257→    }
   258→
   259→    // Use provided path or default VIDEO_PATH
   260→    const char* videoFile = path ? path : VIDEO_PATH;
   261→    f = SD.open(videoFile, FILE_READ);
   262→
   263→    if (!f) {
   264→        return false;
   265→    }
   266→
   267→    _videoSize = f.size();
   268→    _videoBuf = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(_videoSize);
   269→    if (!_videoBuf) {
   270→        f.close();
   271→        return false;
   272→    }
   273→
   274→    if (f.read(_videoBuf, _videoSize) != _videoSize) {
   275→        free(_videoBuf);
   276→        _videoBuf = nullptr;
   277→        f.close();
   278→        return false;
   279→    }
   280→    f.close();
   281→
   282→    // Create stream and decoder
   283→    _stream = new MemoryStream(_videoBuf, _videoSize);
   284→    _decodeBuf = (uint8_t*)malloc(LCD_WIDTH * LCD_HEIGHT / 2);
   285→    if (!_decodeBuf) {
   286→        return false;
   287→    }
   288→
   289→    _decoder = new MjpegClass();
   290→    MjpegClass* mjpeg = (MjpegClass*)_decoder;
   291→
   292→    // Note: With rotation=1, effective display is 320x240 (landscape)
   293→    // MjpegClass uses these for scaling and centering calculations
   294→    return mjpeg->setup(_stream, _decodeBuf, _drawCallback, true, 0, 0, LCD_HEIGHT, LCD_WIDTH);
   295→}

   439→void VideoPlayer::_drawTextBox() {
   440→    if (!_display || _currentText.length() == 0) return;
   441→
   442→    // Get actual display dimensions (accounts for rotation)
   443→    int dispWidth = _display->width();
   444→    int dispHeight = _display->height();
   445→
   446→    // Text box dimensions
   447→    const int boxHeight = 80;
   448→    const int boxMargin = 5;
   449→    const int textPadding = 8;
   450→    const int boxY = dispHeight - boxHeight - boxMargin;
   451→
   452→    // Draw semi-transparent background
   453→    _display->fillRect(boxMargin, boxY, dispWidth - 2 * boxMargin, boxHeight, TEXT_BG_COLOR);
   454→
   455→    // Draw border
   456→    _display->drawRect(boxMargin, boxY, dispWidth - 2 * boxMargin, boxHeight, TEXT_BORDER_COLOR);
   457→    _display->drawRect(boxMargin + 1, boxY + 1, dispWidth - 2 * boxMargin - 2, boxHeight - 2, TEXT_BORDER_COLOR);
   458→
   459→    // Draw text
   460→    _display->setTextColor(TEXT_COLOR);
   461→    _display->setTextSize(2);
   462→    _display->setTextWrap(true);
   463→
   464→    // Calculate text position
   465→    int textX = boxMargin + textPadding;
   466→    int textY = boxY + textPadding;
   467→
   468→    _display->setCursor(textX, textY);
   469→
   470→    // Word wrap manually for better control
   471→    String remaining = _currentText;
   472→    int lineWidth = dispWidth - 2 * boxMargin - 2 * textPadding;
   473→    int charWidth = 12;  // Approximate width per char at size 2
   474→    int charsPerLine = lineWidth / charWidth;
   475→    int lineHeight = 20;
   476→    int maxLines = (boxHeight - 2 * textPadding) / lineHeight;
   477→
   478→    int line = 0;
   479→    while (remaining.length() > 0 && line < maxLines) {
   480→        String lineToPrint;
   481→        if (remaining.length() <= charsPerLine) {
   482→            lineToPrint = remaining;
   483→            remaining = "";
   484→        } else {
   485→            // Find last space before limit
   486→            int breakPoint = charsPerLine;
   487→            while (breakPoint > 0 && remaining[breakPoint] != ' ') {
   488→                breakPoint--;
   489→            }
   490→            if (breakPoint == 0) breakPoint = charsPerLine;
   491→
   492→            lineToPrint = remaining.substring(0, breakPoint);
   493→            remaining = remaining.substring(breakPoint);
   494→            remaining.trim();
   495→        }
   496→
   497→        _display->setCursor(textX, textY + line * lineHeight);
   498→        _display->print(lineToPrint);
   499→        line++;
   500→    }
   501→}

    11→// Static constants
    12→const float OrientationManager::THRESHOLD = 0.5f;
    13→const unsigned long OrientationManager::DEBOUNCE_MS = ORIENTATION_DEBOUNCE_MS;
    14→const unsigned long OrientationManager::POLL_MS = ORIENTATION_POLL_MS;
    15→
    16→// IMU instance and data
    17→static QMI8658 imu;
    18→static calData calibration = {0};
    19→static AccelData accelData;
    20→
    21→OrientationManager::OrientationManager()
    22→    : _currentRotation(1)
    23→    , _pendingRotation(0)
    24→    , _debounceStart(0)
    25→    , _lastPoll(0)
    26→    , _rotationChanged(false)
    27→    , _imuAvailable(false)
    28→{
    29→}
    30→
    31→bool OrientationManager::begin() {
    32→    Wire.begin(I2C_SDA, I2C_SCL);
    33→
    34→    int err = imu.init(calibration, IMU_ADDRESS);
    35→    _imuAvailable = (err == 0);
    36→
    37→    return _imuAvailable;
    38→}
    39→
    40→void OrientationManager::update() {
    41→    if (!_imuAvailable) return;
    42→
    43→    unsigned long now = millis();
    44→    if (now - _lastPoll < POLL_MS) return;
    45→    _lastPoll = now;
    46→
    47→    // Read accelerometer
    48→    imu.update();
    49→    imu.getAccel(&accelData);
    50→    float accelY = accelData.accelY;
    51→
    52→    // Determine desired rotation based on accelY
    53→    uint8_t desiredRotation = 0;
    54→    if (accelY > THRESHOLD) {
    55→        desiredRotation = 1;  // USB on right (normal)
    56→    } else if (accelY < -THRESHOLD) {
    57→        desiredRotation = 3;  // USB on left (180 flip)
    58→    } else {
    59→        desiredRotation = _currentRotation;  // Hysteresis zone - keep current
    60→    }
    61→
    62→    // State machine logic
    63→    if (desiredRotation == _currentRotation) {
    64→        // Orientation matches current stable state
    65→        _pendingRotation = 0;  // Cancel any pending transition
    66→    } else if (_pendingRotation == 0) {
    67→        // Start new transition
    68→        _pendingRotation = desiredRotation;
    69→        _debounceStart = now;
    70→    } else if (_pendingRotation == desiredRotation) {
    71→        // Transition in progress, check if debounce time elapsed
    72→        if (now - _debounceStart >= DEBOUNCE_MS) {
    73→            // Commit rotation change
    74→            _currentRotation = _pendingRotation;
    75→            _pendingRotation = 0;
    76→            _rotationChanged = true;
    77→        }
    78→    } else {
    79→        // Desired rotation changed during debounce - restart
    80→        _pendingRotation = desiredRotation;
    81→        _debounceStart = now;
    82→    }
    83→}
    84→
    85→bool OrientationManager::hasChanged() {
    86→    if (_rotationChanged) {
    87→        _rotationChanged = false;
    88→        return true;
    89→    }
    90→    return false;
    91→}

<cell id="cell-0"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type># Audio Embedding Dataset Generator for ESP32-S3 Phase 3

Generate a large audio-text dataset (~32k samples) for training audio embeddings.

## Auto-Parallelized across 12 GPUs

This notebook automatically distributes work across all available GPUs using multiprocessing.
No manual configuration needed - just run all cells!

## Pipeline
1. Load 2008 questions from `full.csv`
2. Cluster similar questions into buckets for contrastive learning
3. Generate audio with 8 TED voices (XTTS-v2) - **AUTO-PARALLELIZED across 12 GPUs**
4. Apply audio augmentation (gaussian noise, pitch, speed)
5. Extract YAMNet embeddings
6. Train contrastive learning model (with bucketed sampling)
7. Export TFLite for ESP32

## Output
- `audio_projection_quantized.tflite` (~663KB)
- `embeddings.bin` (2008 x 256-dim)
- `intents.txt` (2008 question strings)

---</cell id="cell-0">

<cell id="cell-7"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 3. Load Dataset & Create Buckets

For contrastive learning to work properly:
- Similar questions (e.g., "What is the email" vs "Tell me the email address") should be in the SAME bucket
- During training, we sample ONE audio per bucket per batch
- This ensures negatives are truly different questions, not just audio variations of the same question</cell id="cell-7">
<cell id="cell-8">from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

# Load text encoder for bucketing
print("Loading MiniLM for question bucketing...")
text_encoder = SentenceTransformer('sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2')

# Load questions
qa_file = DATA_DIR / 'full.csv'
if not qa_file.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"full.csv not found at {qa_file}")

qa_df = pd.read_csv(qa_file)
questions = qa_df['question'].tolist()
answers = qa_df['answer'].tolist() if 'answer' in qa_df.columns else [None] * len(questions)

print(f"Loaded {len(questions)} questions")</cell id="cell-8">

<cell id="cell-9"># Encode all questions for clustering
print("Encoding questions for clustering...")
question_embeddings = text_encoder.encode(questions, show_progress_bar=True)
print(f"Question embeddings shape: {question_embeddings.shape}")</cell id="cell-9">

Encoding questions for clustering...


Batches:   0%|          | 0/63 [00:00<?, ?it/s]

<cell id="cell-10"># Cluster similar questions into buckets
print(f"Clustering questions (similarity threshold: {SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD})...")

# Use Agglomerative Clustering with cosine distance
distance_threshold = 1 - SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD  # Convert similarity to distance
clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(
    n_clusters=None,
    distance_threshold=distance_threshold,
    metric='cosine',
    linkage='average'
)
cluster_labels = clustering.fit_predict(question_embeddings)

# Create buckets
buckets = defaultdict(list)
for idx, label in enumerate(cluster_labels):
    buckets[label].append({
        'idx': idx,
        'question': questions[idx],
        'answer': answers[idx],
        'embedding': question_embeddings[idx]
    })

num_buckets = len(buckets)
bucket_sizes = [len(b) for b in buckets.values()]

print(f"\nBucketing Results:")
print(f"  Total questions: {len(questions)}")
print(f"  Number of buckets: {num_buckets}")
print(f"  Avg bucket size: {np.mean(bucket_sizes):.1f}")
print(f"  Min bucket size: {min(bucket_sizes)}")
print(f"  Max bucket size: {max(bucket_sizes)}")

# Show sample buckets
print(f"\nSample buckets (showing first 3):")
for i, (label, items) in enumerate(list(buckets.items())[:3]):

    for item in items[:3]:

<cell id="cell-18"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 7. State Persistence (Resume Capability)</cell id="cell-18">
<cell id="cell-19"># State tracking utilities (used by workers)
def get_state_file(worker_id):
    return LOG_DIR / f'generation_state_worker_{worker_id}.json'

def save_generation_state(worker_id, question_idx, speaker_idx, total_generated):
    """Save generation progress for resume"""
    import json
    from datetime import datetime
    state = {
        'worker_id': worker_id,
        'question_idx': question_idx,
        'speaker_idx': speaker_idx,
        'total_generated': total_generated,
        'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat()
    }
    with open(get_state_file(worker_id), 'w') as f:
        json.dump(state, f, indent=2)

def load_generation_state(worker_id):
    """Load generation progress for resume"""
    import json
    state_file = get_state_file(worker_id)
    if state_file.exists():
        with open(state_file) as f:
            return json.load(f)
    return None

print("State persistence utilities defined")</cell id="cell-19">

State persistence utilities defined

<cell id="cell-20"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 8. Parallel Audio Generation (12 GPUs)

Each GPU runs its own worker process with:
- Dedicated XTTS-v2 model instance
- Pre-computed speaker latents
- Subset of questions to process

All 12 GPUs work simultaneously!</cell id="cell-20">

<cell id="cell-22"># Write worker function to a separate file (required for multiprocessing in Jupyter)
worker_code = '''
import os
import json
import torch
import torchaudio
import librosa
import soundfile as sf
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from tqdm import tqdm
from audiomentations import Compose, AddGaussianNoise, TimeStretch, PitchShift
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore', category=UserWarning, module='torchaudio')
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore', category=FutureWarning)

def gpu_worker(args):
    """Worker function that runs on a specific GPU"""
    worker_id, data = args
    
    # Set this worker to use specific GPU
    os.environ['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES'] = str(worker_id)
    
    # Extract data
    questions = data['questions']
    cluster_labels = data['cluster_labels']
    speaker_files = data['speaker_files']
    num_gpus = data['num_gpus']
    audio_dir = Path(data['audio_dir'])
    log_dir = Path(data['log_dir'])
    
    # Calculate this worker's question range
    questions_per_worker = len(questions) // num_gpus
    start_idx = worker_id * questions_per_worker
    end_idx = start_idx + questions_per_worker if worker_id < num_gpus - 1 else len(questions)
    worker_questions = list(range(start_idx, end_idx))
    
    print(f"[GPU {worker_id}] Starting: questions {start_idx}-{end_idx-1} ({len(worker_questions)} questions)")
    
    # Load XTTS on this GPU
    from TTS.api import TTS
    tts = TTS("tts_models/multilingual/multi-dataset/xtts_v2").to("cuda")
    
    # Pre-compute speaker latents
    print(f"[GPU {worker_id}] Pre-computing speaker latents...")
    speaker_latents = {}
    for sf_path in speaker_files:
        gpt_cond_latent, speaker_embedding = tts.synthesizer.tts_model.get_conditioning_latents(
            audio_path=sf_path
        )
        speaker_latents[sf_path] = (gpt_cond_latent, speaker_embedding)
    
    # Setup augmentation
    augmenter = Compose([
        AddGaussianNoise(min_amplitude=0.005, max_amplitude=0.02, p=1.0),
        TimeStretch(min_rate=0.9, max_rate=1.1, p=0.5),
        PitchShift(min_semitones=-2, max_semitones=2, p=0.5),
    ])
    
    # Check for resume
    state_file = log_dir / f'generation_state_worker_{worker_id}.json'
    if state_file.exists():
        with open(state_file) as f:
            state = json.load(f)
        resume_q_idx = state['question_idx']
        resume_s_idx = state['speaker_idx']
        total_generated = state['total_generated']
        print(f"[GPU {worker_id}] Resuming from q{resume_q_idx}, s{resume_s_idx}")
    else:
        resume_q_idx = start_idx
        resume_s_idx = 0
        total_generated = 0
    
    metadata = []
    
    # Process questions
    for q_idx in tqdm(worker_questions, desc=f"GPU {worker_id}", position=worker_id, leave=True):
        if q_idx < resume_q_idx:
            continue
        
        question = questions[q_idx]
        bucket_id = int(cluster_labels[q_idx])
        output_dir = audio_dir / f'bucket_{bucket_id}'
        output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        for s_idx, speaker_file in enumerate(speaker_files):
            if q_idx == resume_q_idx and s_idx < resume_s_idx:
                continue
            
            base_name = f'q{q_idx:04d}_s{s_idx}'
            audio_file = output_dir / f'{base_name}.wav'
            
            if not audio_file.exists():
                try:
                    # Generate audio
                    gpt_cond_latent, speaker_embedding = speaker_latents[speaker_file]
                    out = tts.synthesizer.tts_model.inference(
                        question, "en", gpt_cond_latent, speaker_embedding
                    )
                    wav_tensor = torch.tensor(out["wav"]).unsqueeze(0)
                    torchaudio.save(str(audio_file), wav_tensor, 24000)
                    
                    # Load and create augmented version
                    audio, sr = librosa.load(str(audio_file), sr=16000, mono=True)
                    
                    metadata.append({
                        'file': str(audio_file),
                        'text': question,
                        'question_idx': q_idx,
                        'bucket_id': bucket_id,
                        'speaker': s_idx,
                        'variant': 'original',
                        'worker_id': worker_id
                    })
                    
                    # Augmented version
                    audio_aug = augmenter(samples=audio, sample_rate=sr)
                    aug_file = output_dir / f'{base_name}_aug.wav'
                    sf.write(str(aug_file), audio_aug, sr)
                    
                    metadata.append({
                        'file': str(aug_file),
                        'text': question,
                        'question_idx': q_idx,
                        'bucket_id': bucket_id,
                        'speaker': s_idx,
                        'variant': 'augmented',
                        'worker_id': worker_id
                    })
                    
                    total_generated += 2
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"[GPU {worker_id}] Error {base_name}: {e}")
                    continue
            
            # Save state periodically
            if total_generated % 50 == 0 and total_generated > 0:
                state = {
                    'worker_id': worker_id,
                    'question_idx': q_idx,
                    'speaker_idx': s_idx,
                    'total_generated': total_generated,
                    'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat()
                }
                with open(state_file, 'w') as f:
                    json.dump(state, f, indent=2)
    
    # Save metadata
    metadata_file = audio_dir / f'metadata_worker_{worker_id}.json'
    with open(metadata_file, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(metadata, f, indent=2)
    
    print(f"[GPU {worker_id}] DONE! Generated {total_generated} files")
    return worker_id, total_generated
'''

# Write to file
worker_file = WORK_DIR / 'gpu_worker.py'
with open(worker_file, 'w') as f:
    f.write(worker_code)

print(f"Worker module written to: {worker_file}")</cell id="cell-22">

<cell id="cell-26"># Merge metadata from all GPU workers and extract embeddings

def load_audio_for_yamnet(file_path, target_sr=16000, target_length=3):
    """Load and prepare audio for YAMNet (3 seconds, 16kHz)"""
    audio, sr = librosa.load(file_path, sr=target_sr, mono=True)
    
    # Pad or trim to target length
    target_samples = target_length * target_sr
    if len(audio) < target_samples:
        audio = np.pad(audio, (0, target_samples - len(audio)))
    else:
        audio = audio[:target_samples]
    
    return audio.astype(np.float32)

# Merge metadata from all GPU workers
print("Merging metadata from all GPU workers...")
metadata = []
for worker_id in range(NUM_GPUS):
    worker_metadata_file = AUDIO_DIR / f'metadata_worker_{worker_id}.json'
    if worker_metadata_file.exists():
        with open(worker_metadata_file) as f:
            worker_data = json.load(f)
            metadata.extend(worker_data)
            print(f"  GPU {worker_id}: {len(worker_data)} entries")
    else:
        print(f"  GPU {worker_id}: NOT FOUND!")

print(f"\nTotal metadata entries: {len(metadata)}")

if len(metadata) == 0:
    raise RuntimeError("No metadata found! Check worker outputs.")

# Save merged metadata
merged_metadata_file = AUDIO_DIR / 'metadata.json'
with open(merged_metadata_file, 'w') as f:
    json.dump(metadata, f, indent=2)
print(f"Merged metadata saved: {merged_metadata_file}")

print(f"\nExtracting YAMNet embeddings...")
print(f"Total files: {len(metadata)}")

audio_embeddings = []
valid_metadata = []

for item in tqdm(metadata):
    file_path = item['file']
    
    if not Path(file_path).exists():
        continue
    
    try:
        audio = load_audio_for_yamnet(file_path)
        _, embeddings, _ = yamnet_model(audio)
        avg_embedding = tf.reduce_mean(embeddings, axis=0).numpy()
        
        audio_embeddings.append(avg_embedding)
        valid_metadata.append(item)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\nError processing {file_path}: {e}")
        continue

audio_embeddings = np.array(audio_embeddings)
print(f"\nYAMNet embeddings shape: {audio_embeddings.shape}")
print(f"Valid samples: {len(valid_metadata)}")</cell id="cell-26">

<cell id="cell-32"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 13. Bucketed Batch Sampler for Contrastive Learning

**Key insight**: For contrastive loss to work, each batch must have:
- ONE audio sample per bucket (no duplicates from same bucket)
- This ensures all other samples in the batch are true negatives</cell id="cell-32">
<cell id="cell-33">class BucketedBatchGenerator:
    """Generate batches where each sample is from a different bucket.
    
    This ensures proper contrastive learning where negatives are truly
    from different questions, not just different audio of the same question.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, audio_embs, text_embs, bucket_ids, batch_size):
        self.audio_embs = audio_embs
        self.text_embs = text_embs
        self.bucket_ids = bucket_ids
        self.batch_size = batch_size
        
        # Group samples by bucket
        self.bucket_to_indices = defaultdict(list)
        for idx, bid in enumerate(bucket_ids):
            self.bucket_to_indices[bid].append(idx)
        
        self.all_buckets = list(self.bucket_to_indices.keys())
        
        # Ensure batch_size <= num_buckets
        if batch_size > len(self.all_buckets):
            print(f"Warning: batch_size ({batch_size}) > num_buckets ({len(self.all_buckets)})")
            print(f"Reducing batch_size to {len(self.all_buckets)}")
            self.batch_size = len(self.all_buckets)
    
    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.audio_embs) // self.batch_size
    
    def generate_batch(self):
        """Generate one batch with one sample per bucket."""
        # Randomly select batch_size buckets
        selected_buckets = random.sample(self.all_buckets, self.batch_size)
        
        batch_audio = []
        batch_text = []
        
        for bucket_id in selected_buckets:
            # Randomly select one sample from this bucket
            idx = random.choice(self.bucket_to_indices[bucket_id])
            batch_audio.append(self.audio_embs[idx])
            batch_text.append(self.text_embs[idx])
        
        return np.array(batch_audio), np.array(batch_text)
    
    def generate_epoch(self):
        """Generate batches for one epoch."""
        for _ in range(len(self)):
            yield self.generate_batch()

# Create batch generator
batch_generator = BucketedBatchGenerator(
    audio_embeddings,
    text_embeddings,
    bucket_ids,
    BATCH_SIZE
)

print(f"Bucketed Batch Generator:")
print(f"  Samples: {len(audio_embeddings)}")
print(f"  Buckets: {len(batch_generator.all_buckets)}")
print(f"  Batch size: {batch_generator.batch_size}")
print(f"  Batches per epoch: {len(batch_generator)}")</cell id="cell-33">
<cell id="cell-34"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type>## 14. Contrastive Training with Bucketed Sampling</cell id="cell-34">
<cell id="cell-35">class ContrastiveLoss(tf.keras.losses.Loss):
    def __init__(self, temperature=0.2, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self.temperature = temperature
    
    def call(self, audio_emb, text_emb):
        logits = tf.matmul(audio_emb, text_emb, transpose_b=True) / self.temperature
        batch_size = tf.shape(audio_emb)[0]
        labels = tf.range(batch_size)
        
        loss_a2t = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=logits)
        loss_t2a = tf.nn.sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(labels=labels, logits=tf.transpose(logits))
        
        return (tf.reduce_mean(loss_a2t) + tf.reduce_mean(loss_t2a)) / 2

# Setup
optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LEARNING_RATE)
loss_fn = ContrastiveLoss(temperature=TEMPERATURE)

@tf.function
def train_step(audio_batch, text_batch):
    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        audio_proj = audio_projection(audio_batch, training=True)
        text_proj = text_projection(text_batch, training=True)
        loss = loss_fn(audio_proj, text_proj)
    
    variables = audio_projection.trainable_variables + text_projection.trainable_variables
    gradients = tape.gradient(loss, variables)
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(gradients, variables))
    return loss

print("Training setup complete")</cell id="cell-35">
<cell id="cell-36"># Training loop
print(f"Training for {EPOCHS} epochs with bucketed sampling...")
print(f"  Batch size: {batch_generator.batch_size}")
print(f"  Batches per epoch: {len(batch_generator)}")

history = {'loss': []}
best_loss = float('inf')

for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    epoch_losses = []
    
    for audio_batch, text_batch in batch_generator.generate_epoch():
        audio_batch = tf.constant(audio_batch, dtype=tf.float32)
        text_batch = tf.constant(text_batch, dtype=tf.float32)
        
        loss = train_step(audio_batch, text_batch)
        epoch_losses.append(loss.numpy())
    
    avg_loss = np.mean(epoch_losses)
    history['loss'].append(avg_loss)
    
    # Learning rate decay
    if epoch > 0 and epoch % 50 == 0:
        if avg_loss >= best_loss:
            new_lr = optimizer.learning_rate.numpy() * 0.5
            if new_lr >= 1e-6:
                optimizer.learning_rate.assign(new_lr)
                print(f"\nEpoch {epoch}: LR reduced to {new_lr:.2e}")
    
    if avg_loss < best_loss:
        best_loss = avg_loss
    
    if (epoch + 1) % 10 == 0:
        print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS} - Loss: {avg_loss:.4f} - Best: {best_loss:.4f}")

print(f"\nTraining complete!")
print(f"Final loss: {history['loss'][-1]:.4f}")
print(f"Best loss: {best_loss:.4f}")</cell id="cell-36">

<cell id="cell-0"><cell_type>markdown</cell_type># microWakeWord Training Notebook

Train a custom wake word detection model compatible with ESP32-S3.

## Overview

This notebook trains models compatible with `wakeword_pretrained_test.ino`:
- **Input**: 40-bin log-mel spectrogram features (30ms window, 10ms stride)
- **Architecture**: MixNet-based streaming model
- **Output**: Quantized TFLite model for ESP32

Based on: https://github.com/kahrendt/microWakeWord</cell id="cell-0">

<cell id="cell-4"># Patch microWakeWord for TensorFlow 2.17 compatibility
# TF 2.17 returns numpy arrays directly instead of tensors, so .numpy() calls fail

import re

train_py = '/workspace/microWakeWord/microwakeword/train.py'

with open(train_py, 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Check if already patched
if 'np.asarray' not in content:
    # Replace patterns like: result["fp"].numpy() -> np.asarray(result["fp"])
    # This handles both tensor (needs .numpy()) and numpy array (already is) cases
    patched = re.sub(
        r'(\w+)\[(["\'])(\w+)\2\]\.numpy\(\)',
        r'np.asarray(\1["\3"])',
        content
    )
    
    with open(train_py, 'w') as f:
        f.write(patched)
    
    print("✓ Patched train.py for TensorFlow 2.17 compatibility")
else:
    print("✓ train.py already patched")</cell id="cell-4">

✓ train.py already patched

import urllib.request

speaker_voices_dir = WORK_DIR / 'speaker_voices'

speaker_files = []
for speaker in TED_SPEAKERS:
    for sample_idx in range(SAMPLES_PER_SPEAKER):
        wav_path = speaker_voices_dir / f'ted_{speaker}_{sample_idx}.wav'
        mp3_path = speaker_voices_dir / f'ted_{speaker}_{sample_idx}.mp3'
        
        if not wav_path.exists():
            try:
                url = f'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/audio-samples/audio-samples.github.io/master/samples/mp3/ted_speakers/{speaker}/sample-{sample_idx}.mp3'
                urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, mp3_path)
                audio, sr = librosa.load(mp3_path, sr=16000, mono=True)
                if len(audio) > 6 * 16000:
                    audio = audio[:6 * 16000]
                sf.write(str(wav_path), audio, 16000)
                mp3_path.unlink()
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  ✗ {speaker}/sample-{sample_idx}: {e}")
                continue
        speaker_files.append(str(wav_path))
    print(f"  ✓ {speaker} ({SAMPLES_PER_SPEAKER} samples)")

print(f"\n✓ Downloaded {len(speaker_files)} voice references")</cell id="cell-11">

<cell id="cell-12">#=============================================================================
# PHASE 3: XTTS GENERATION (SKIP IF DATA EXISTS)
#=============================================================================
if SKIP_GENERATION:
    print("✓ Skipping XTTS generation - using existing data")
else:
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("PHASE 3: XTTS-v2 GENERATION")
    print("="*60)

    import torch
    from TTS.api import TTS

    # Build task list: (variation_text, speaker_wav, output_path)
    xtts_tasks = []
    for i, variation in enumerate(PHONETIC_VARIATIONS):
        for speaker_wav in speaker_files:
            speaker_name = Path(speaker_wav).stem
            output_path = str(training_dir / f"xtts_var{i}_{speaker_name}.wav")
            # Skip if already generated (resume support)
            if not Path(output_path).exists():
                xtts_tasks.append((variation, speaker_wav, output_path))

    total_tasks = len(PHONETIC_VARIATIONS) * len(speaker_files)
    already_done = total_tasks - len(xtts_tasks)

    print(f"  Total XTTS tasks: {total_tasks}")
    if already_done > 0:
        print(f"  Already completed: {already_done} (resuming...)")
    print(f"  Remaining: {len(xtts_tasks)}")

    if len(xtts_tasks) > 0:
        # Load XTTS model
        device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
        print(f"\n  Loading XTTS-v2 on {device}...")
        xtts = TTS("tts_models/multilingual/multi-dataset/xtts_v2").to(device)
        print("  Model loaded!")
        
        # Sequential generation with progress
        failed = 0
        for idx, (variation, speaker_wav, output_path) in enumerate(xtts_tasks):
            # Progress every 80 samples (1 variation * 80 voices)
            if idx % 80 == 0:
                pct = 100 * (idx + already_done) // total_tasks
                print(f"  Progress: {idx + already_done}/{total_tasks} ({pct}%)")
            
            try:
                xtts.tts_to_file(
                    text=variation,
                    file_path=output_path,
                    speaker_wav=speaker_wav,
                    language="en"
                )
            except Exception as e:
                failed += 1
                if failed <= 5:  # Only show first 5 errors
                    print(f"    ✗ {Path(output_path).stem}: {e}")
        
        # Cleanup
        del xtts
        gc.collect()
        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
        
        if failed > 0:
            print(f"\n  ⚠ {failed} samples failed")

    xtts_count = len(list(training_dir.glob('xtts_*.wav')))
    print(f"\n✓ XTTS complete: {xtts_count} samples")
    gc.collect()</cell id="cell-12">

    print(f"AudioSet already has {len(existing)} samples, skipping download")
else:
    try:
        from datasets import load_dataset
        import soundfile as sf
        print("Loading AudioSet subset via datasets library...")
        
        # Load balanced subset with streaming
        ds = load_dataset(
            "agkphysics/AudioSet", 
            split="train",
            streaming=True,
        )
        
        # Save first 500 audio samples as wav files
        count = 0
        max_samples = 500
        
        for sample in ds:
            if count >= max_samples:
                break
            try:
                audio = sample['audio']
                wav_path = AUDIOSET_DIR / f"audioset_{count:04d}.wav"
                sf.write(str(wav_path), audio['array'], audio['sampling_rate'])
                count += 1
                if count % 100 == 0:
                    print(f"  Saved {count}/{max_samples} samples")
            except Exception:
                continue  # Skip problematic samples
        
        print(f"Done! Saved {count} background audio samples")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"AudioSet loading failed: {e}")
        print("Background augmentation will use MIT impulse responses only.")</cell id="cell-19">

<cell id="cell-22"># Cell 10: Configure augmentation
from microwakeword.audio.augmentation import Augmentation

# Verify we have background noise files
audioset_files = list(AUDIOSET_DIR.glob('*.wav'))
if len(audioset_files) == 0:
    raise RuntimeError(f"No AudioSet files found in {AUDIOSET_DIR}! Re-run AudioSet download cell.")

augmentation = Augmentation(
    augmentation_duration_s=3.2,
    augmentation_probabilities={
        "SevenBandParametricEQ": 0.1,
        "TanhDistortion": 0.1,
        "PitchShift": 0.1,
        "BandStopFilter": 0.1,
        "AddColorNoise": 0.1,
        "AddBackgroundNoise": 0.75,
        "Gain": 1.0,
        "RIR": 0.5,
    },
    impulse_paths=[str(MIT_IR_DIR / 'Audio')],
    background_paths=[str(AUDIOSET_DIR)],
)
print(f"Augmentation configured with {len(audioset_files)} background noise files")</cell id="cell-22">

<cell id="cell-23"># Cell 11: Generate spectrogram features from audio samples
from microwakeword.audio.clips import Clips
from microwakeword.audio.spectrograms import SpectrogramGeneration
from mmap_ninja.ragged import RaggedMmap
import os

POSITIVE_FEATURES_DIR = FEATURES_DIR / 'positive'

# Check if features already exist
train_mmap = POSITIVE_FEATURES_DIR / 'training' / 'wakeword_mmap'
if train_mmap.exists():
    print("✓ Features already exist, skipping generation")
else:
    print("Generating spectrogram features from audio samples...")
    print(f"  Source: {training_dir} ({len(list(training_dir.glob('*.wav')))} wav files)")
    print(f"  Output: {POSITIVE_FEATURES_DIR}")
    print()
    
    # Create Clips object pointing to audio files
    clips = Clips(
        input_directory=str(training_dir),
        file_pattern='*.wav',
        max_clip_duration_s=None,
        remove_silence=False,
        random_split_seed=10,
        split_count=0.1,  # 10% for validation
    )
    
    # Create output directories
    POSITIVE_FEATURES_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    splits = ["training", "validation"]
    for split in splits:
        out_dir = POSITIVE_FEATURES_DIR / split
        out_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        
        split_name = "train" if split == "training" else "validation"
        repetition = 10 if split == "training" else 1  # More augmented copies for training
        
        spectrograms = SpectrogramGeneration(
            clips=clips,
            augmenter=augmentation,
            slide_frames=10,
            step_ms=10,
        )
        
        print(f"  Generating {split} features (repeat={repetition})...")
        RaggedMmap.from_generator(
            out_dir=str(out_dir / 'wakeword_mmap'),
            sample_generator=spectrograms.spectrogram_generator(
                split=split_name, 
                repeat=repetition
            ),
            batch_size=100,
            verbose=True,
        )
    
    print("\n✓ Feature generation complete")

# Verify
train_features = RaggedMmap(str(POSITIVE_FEATURES_DIR / 'training' / 'wakeword_mmap'), mode='r')
val_features = RaggedMmap(str(POSITIVE_FEATURES_DIR / 'validation' / 'wakeword_mmap'), mode='r')
print(f"  Training features: {len(train_features)} spectrograms")
print(f"  Validation features: {len(val_features)} spectrograms")</cell id="cell-23">

#!/bin/bash
# Upload files to ESP32 FFat partition using mkfatfs

set -e

echo "ESP32-S3 FFat Flash Upload Tool"
echo "================================"
echo

# Check if data directory exists
if [ ! -d "data" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: data/ folder not found!"
    exit 1
fi

# Check if video file exists
if [ ! -f "data/output.mjpeg" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: data/output.mjpeg not found!"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Found video file: data/output.mjpeg"
FILE_SIZE=$(stat -c%s "data/output.mjpeg" 2>/dev/null || stat -f%z "data/output.mjpeg")
echo "Size: $FILE_SIZE bytes ($(($FILE_SIZE / 1024)) KB)"
echo

# Find mkfatfs tool
MKFATFS=$(find ~/.arduino15/packages/esp32/tools/mkfatfs -name "mkfatfs" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1)

if [ -z "$MKFATFS" ]; then
    # Try local temp folder
    MKFATFS="./temp/mkfatfs"
    if [ ! -f "$MKFATFS" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: mkfatfs tool not found!"
        echo "Please run: ./install_mkfatfs.sh"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "Found tool: $MKFATFS"
echo

# FFat partition details from app3M_fat9M_16MB.csv
# ffat, data, fat, 0x610000, 0x9E0000
PARTITION_OFFSET="0x610000"
PARTITION_SIZE="10354688"  # 0x9E0000 in decimal

# According to notes: image is flashed with +4096 bytes (0x1000) offset
FLASH_OFFSET="0x611000"  # 0x610000 + 0x1000

echo "Creating FAT filesystem image..."
echo "Partition size: $PARTITION_SIZE bytes"

$MKFATFS -c data -t fatfs -s $PARTITION_SIZE ffat.bin

if [ ! -f "ffat.bin" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Failed to create filesystem image"
    exit 1
fi

IMAGE_SIZE=$(stat -c%s "ffat.bin" 2>/dev/null || stat -f%z "ffat.bin")
echo "Filesystem image created: ffat.bin ($IMAGE_SIZE bytes)"
echo

# Find esptool
ESPTOOL=$(which esptool.py 2>/dev/null || which esptool 2>/dev/null || echo "")

if [ -z "$ESPTOOL" ]; then
    ESPTOOL=$(find ~/.arduino15/packages/esp32/tools -name "esptool.py" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1)
fi

if [ -z "$ESPTOOL" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: esptool not found!"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Found esptool: $ESPTOOL"
echo

# Find ESP32 port
echo "Looking for ESP32 device..."
PORT=""

for p in /dev/ttyUSB* /dev/ttyACM* /dev/cu.usbserial* /dev/cu.usbmodem*; do
    if [ -e "$p" ]; then
        PORT="$p"
        break
    fi
done

if [ -z "$PORT" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: No ESP32 device found!"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Found ESP32 on: $PORT"
echo

echo "Uploading to flash..."
echo "Flash offset: $FLASH_OFFSET (+0x1000 from partition start)"
echo
read -p "Continue? (y/n) " -n 1 -r
echo
if [[ ! $REPLY =~ ^[Yy]$ ]]; then
    echo "Cancelled."
    exit 0
fi

# Upload to ESP32 (with 0x1000 offset from partition start)
python3 $ESPTOOL --chip esp32s3 --port $PORT --baud 460800 \
    write_flash $FLASH_OFFSET ffat.bin

echo
echo "SUCCESS! Flash upload complete"
echo
echo "Now:"
echo "1. Press RESET button on ESP32"
echo "2. Open Serial Monitor (115200 baud)"
echo "3. Video should play!"
echo

# Cleanup
rm -f ffat.bin
echo "Cleaned up temporary file (ffat.bin)"

   173→bool MicStream::_captureAudio() {
   174→    int space_available = AUDIO_BUFFER_SIZE - _audioBufferPos;
   175→    if (space_available < 256) {
   176→        return true;  // Buffer full, will process
   177→    }
   178→
   179→    int samples_to_read = min(256, space_available);
   180→    size_t bytes_read;
   181→    if (i2s_read(I2S_NUM_0, _i2sBuffer, samples_to_read * 4, &bytes_read, 10) != ESP_OK) {
   182→        return false;
   183→    }
   184→
   185→    int samples = bytes_read / 4;
   186→    int32_t max_sample = 0;
   187→
   188→    for (int i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
   189→        // INMP441 sends 24-bit in 32-bit frame, shift down
   190→        int32_t sample = _i2sBuffer[i] >> 14;
   191→        _audioBuffer[_audioBufferPos++] = constrain(sample, -32768, 32767);
   192→        if (abs(sample) > max_sample) max_sample = abs(sample);
   193→    }
   194→
   195→    _amplitude = max_sample;
   196→    return true;
   197→}
   198→
   199→bool MicStream::update() {
   200→    if (!_running) return false;
   201→
   202→    if (!_captureAudio()) {
   203→        return false;
   204→    }
   205→
   206→    bool newFrame = false;
   207→
   208→    // Process audio through frontend when we have enough samples
   209→    while (_audioBufferPos >= FEATURE_STRIDE_SAMPLES) {
   210→        size_t num_samples_read;
   211→        FrontendOutput frontend_output = FrontendProcessSamples(
   212→            _frontendState, _audioBuffer, _audioBufferPos, &num_samples_read);
   213→
   214→        if (num_samples_read == 0) {
   215→            break;
   216→        }
   217→
   218→        // Shift remaining samples to start of buffer
   219→        if (num_samples_read < (size_t)_audioBufferPos) {
   220→            memmove(_audioBuffer, _audioBuffer + num_samples_read,
   221→                    (_audioBufferPos - num_samples_read) * sizeof(int16_t));
   222→        }
   223→        _audioBufferPos -= num_samples_read;
   224→
   225→        // If we got features, add to feature buffer
   226→        if (frontend_output.size == FEATURE_BINS) {
   227→            // Shift feature frames if buffer is full
   228→            if (_featureFrameCount >= FEATURE_FRAMES) {
   229→                memmove(_featureBuffer, _featureBuffer + FEATURE_BINS,
   230→                        (FEATURE_FRAMES - 1) * FEATURE_BINS * sizeof(uint16_t));
   231→                _featureFrameCount = FEATURE_FRAMES - 1;
   232→            }
   233→
   234→            // Add new frame
   235→            memcpy(_featureBuffer + _featureFrameCount * FEATURE_BINS,
   236→                   frontend_output.values, FEATURE_BINS * sizeof(uint16_t));
   237→            _featureFrameCount++;
   238→
   239→            // Signal that we have a complete feature set
   240→            if (_featureFrameCount >= FEATURE_FRAMES) {
   241→                newFrame = true;
   242→            }
   243→        }
   244→    }
   245→
   246→    return newFrame;
   247→}
   248→
   249→int MicStream::getNewSamples(int16_t* buffer, size_t maxSamples) {
   250→    // This provides raw audio for recording purposes
   251→    // For now, return what's in buffer (caller should copy before next update)
   252→    int count = min((size_t)_audioBufferPos, maxSamples);
   253→    if (count > 0 && buffer) {
   254→        memcpy(buffer, _audioBuffer, count * sizeof(int16_t));
   255→    }
   256→    return count;
   257→}
